derivation: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting;

occurrences.text: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.
